title: Susans Hat Shop AH127 International Resourcing Services 1997 Resin Village House
conditionDescription: Light wear, small chips/rubs along the base edges and roof ridge - see close-ups. No box.
descriptionText:
"Susan's Hat Shop" (AH127) - International Resourcing Services, Inc., 1997. Miniature resin Victorian-style shop with the yellow SUSAN'S HAT SHOP sign, "New Arrivals" display windows with hats on stands, teal shutters and door, terracotta roof, and landscaped grass base with pine tree and flower pots. Green felt underside with the original gold foil label. About 3.5 inches tall.

No box - figurine only.

Condition: Pre-owned. Light wear and some small paint chips/rubs, mostly along the base edges and roof ridge (see close-up photos). Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
